prompts.camp:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create an actual production game asset, not a mockup. Art direction: weathered dark-fantasy woodland RPG, crisp hand-placed-looking pixel art with chunky deliberate pixel clusters, restrained detail, no antialiasing, no gradients, no blur. Shared colors: near-black navy #181425, charcoal #262b44, slate #3a4466, dark bark #3e2731, earth #8b9b72, muted brass #be985f, warm cream #e8d4a0, ember #f77622. Quiet, grounded, worn materials, not cute. No letters, words, logos, watermark, interface labels, or characters.
Asset: wide landscape camp illustration, aspect ratio 3:2. A small practical patched canvas tent on the left, a stone-ring campfire on the right, a kettle on a crooked iron stand, dark spruce forest and a broken distant watchtower under an indigo dusk sky. Small warm lantern on a post beside the tent, stacked firewood. Central lower foreground is a broad empty flat dirt clearing, completely unobstructed, to place the separate player sprite at runtime at x=50%, y=86%. Keep the tent and fire in the middle third vertically so this can crop to a wide 2:1 banner. Highest contrast on flame and canvas, subdued tree silhouettes, only a few embers. Full bleed environment, no frame, no people.

Asset: ONE square reusable UI panel frame. Orthographic front view. A thin rectangular worn dark-bronze metal border with small angular riveted corner plates, outermost edge at the exact image edges. The border occupies ONLY the outermost 8 percent of each edge. Symmetrical straight bars, small gold highlights and tiny scratches at the corners, no ornaments in the center of any bar. The INNER 84 percent is completely flat opaque charcoal navy #262b44. No perspective. No drop shadow outside the frame. No padding or margin outside the border. Intended to be nine-sliced into responsive game cards, so edge middle sections are straight and repeatable. Brass is muted, not bright yellow. No objects, no icons, no text.
